```c
/*******************************************************************************
* McStas, neutron ray-tracing package
*
* Instrument: ILL_D2B powder diffractometer
*
* %D
* ILL powder diffractometer D2B simulation.
*
* %P
* lambda: [Angs] Wavelength
* DM: [Angs] Monochromator d-spacing
* Powder: [str] Powder reflection file name
* RV: [m] Monochromator vertical curvature
* L1: [m] Source-monochromator distance
* L2: [m] Monochromator-sample distance
* L3: [m] Sample-detector distance
* verbose: [int] Verbose output flag
* ALPHA1: [min] Primary collimation
* ALPHA2: [min] Secondary collimation
* ALPHA3: [min] Tertiary collimation (radial collimator)
* ETA: [min] Monochromator mosaic
* THETA_M: [deg] Monochromator take-off angle / 2
* TILT: [deg] Monochromator tilt
* SM: [1] Monochromator sense (+1 or -1)
* Dheight: [m] Detector height
* coating: [1] Guide coating m-value
*
* %L
* %E
*******************************************************************************/

DEFINE INSTRUMENT ILL_D2B(
  lambda=1.594,
  DM=0,
  string Powder="Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz",
  RV=-1,
  L1=16.05,
  L2=2.645,
  L3=1.3,
  verbose=1,
  ALPHA1=18,
  ALPHA2=11,
  ALPHA3=5,
  ETA=12,
  THETA_M=67.5,
  TILT=0,
  SM=1,
  Dheight=0.3,
  coating=0
)

DECLARE
%{
  double L;
  double KI, Vi, EI;
  double ALPHA3_Opt;
  double U, V, W, L0;
  char lamopts[256];
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  if (!THETA_M && lambda && DM)
    THETA_M = asin(lambda/(2*DM))*RAD2DEG;
  else if (THETA_M && !lambda && DM)
    lambda = fabs(sin(THETA_M*DEG2RAD))*2*DM;
  else if (THETA_M && lambda)
    DM = fabs(lambda/sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M)/2.0);
  THETA_M *= SM; /* take-off direction left or right */
  
  if (!THETA_M || !DM || !lambda) 
    exit(fprintf(stderr,
          "ILL_D2B: ERROR: Monochromator take-off, d-spacing or wavelength is null (THETA_M=%g, DM=%g, lambda=%g). Abort.\n",
          THETA_M, DM, lambda));
          
  if (!L1)    L = L2;
  else        L = 1/(1/L1+1/L2);
  
  if (RV < 0) RV = 2*L*sin(DEG2RD*THETA_M); /* wait, DEG2RAD */
  if (RV < 0) RV = 2*L*sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M);
  
  KI = 2*PI/lambda;
  Vi = K2V*fabs(KI);
  EI = VS2E*Vi*Vi;
  
  if (ALPHA1 < 0) ALPHA1 = 600;
  if (ALPHA2 < 0) ALPHA2 = 600;
  if (ALPHA3 < 0) ALPHA3 = 600;
  if (ETA <= 0)   ETA    = 30;
  
  U = 4*(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ETA*ETA + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 * ETA*ETA)
       /(tan(THETA_M*DEG2RAD)*tan(THETA_M*DEG2RAD) * (ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA));
  V = 4*ALPHA2*ALPHA2*(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + 2*ETA*ETA)
       /(tan(THETA_M*DEG2RAD) * (ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA));
  W = ALPHA3*ALPHA3+(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ALPHA2*ALPHA2 * ETA*ETA)
                   /(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA);
                   
  L0 = (ALPHA1*ETA*ALPHA2*ALPHA3/tan(fabs(THETA_M)*DEG2RAD))
     / sqrt(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA);
     
  ALPHA3_Opt = 1/sqrt(1/ALPHA1/ALPHA1+1/ALPHA2/ALPHA2+1/ETA/ETA);
  
  if (verbose) {
    printf("ILL_D2B: Detailed DIF configuration\n");
    printf("* Incoming beam: lambda=%.4g [Angs] EI=%.4g [meV]  KI=%.4g [Angs-1] Vi=%g [m/s]\n",
      lambda, EI, KI, Vi);
    printf("* Monochromator:  DM=%.4g [Angs] RV=%.4g [m] %s, take-off 2*THETA_M=%.4g [deg]\n",
      DM, RV, (!RV ? "flat" : "curved"), THETA_M*2);
    printf("* Resolution:     Caglioti              U=%g V=%g W=%g [deg^2]\n", U/60/60, V/60/60, W/60/60);
    printf("                  Optimal          ALPHA3=%g [min]\n",  ALPHA3_Opt);
    printf("                  Optimal resolution A1/2=%g [min]\n",  ALPHA3_Opt/sqrt(2));
    printf("                  Normalized Intensity L0=%g [min^3]\n", L0);
  }
  
  RV = fabs(RV)*SM;
  sprintf(lamopts, "lambda limits=[%g, %g]", lambda*0.99, lambda*1.01);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
  AT [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Source = Source_gen(
  radius=0.11,
  dist=11,
  focus_xw=fabs(0.05*fabs(sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M))),
  focus_yh=0.3,
  lambda0=lambda,
  dlambda=lambda*0.01,
  I1=0.5874e+13,
  T1=683.7,
  T2=257.7,
  I2=2.5099e+13,
  T3=16.7,
  I3=1.0343e+12)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Win0 = Slit(
  radius=0.11)
  AT [0, 0, 2.462] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Oct1 = Slit(
  xwidth=0.15,
  yheight=0.15)
  AT [0, 0, 2.512] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Oct2 = Slit(
  xwidth=0.177,
  yheight=0.177)
  AT [0, 0, 2.512] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 45] RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win1 = Slit(
  radius=0.0565)
  AT [0, 0, 3.5321] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Win2 = Slit(
  radius=0.0555)
  AT [0, 0, 4.0421] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Win3 = Slit(
  radius=0.0575)
  AT [0, 0, 4.087] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Win4 = Slit(
  radius=0.0575)
  AT [0, 0, 4.999] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Win5 = Slit(
  radius=0.0625)
  AT [0, 0, 5.006] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Win6 = Slit(
  radius=0.0625)
  AT [0, 0, 5.151] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT SMguide = Guide(
  w1=0.07,
  h1=0.3,
  l=5,
  m=coating)
  AT [0, 0, 11] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE
  WHEN (coating > 0)

COMPONENT Alpha_One = Collimator_linear(
  xwidth=0.07,
  yheight=0.30,
  length=0.70,
  divergence=ALPHA1,
  transmission=1.0)
  AT [0, 0, L1-1.045] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE
  WHEN (ALPHA1 > 0)

COMPONENT Slit_Mono = Slit(
  xwidth=0.05,
  yheight=0.3)
  AT [0, 0, L1-0.1] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D2B_Mono_XY = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth=0.1,
  yheight=0.3,
  bins=40,
  restore_neutron=1,
  options="x y")
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Slit_Mono ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D2B_ALPHA1_Div = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth=0.1,
  yheight=0.3,
  bins=40,
  restore_neutron=1,
  options="dx limits=[-0.5 0.5] dy limits=[-1 1]")
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE D2B_Mono_XY ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D2B_Mono_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth=0.1,
  yheight=0.3,
  bins=40,
  restore_neutron=1,
  options=lamopts)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE D2B_ALPHA1_Div ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT mono_cradle = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, L1] RELATIVE Origin ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Monok = Monochromator_curved(
  NH=1,
  NV=28,
  mosaich=ETA,
  mosaicv=12,
  RV=RV,
  DM=DM,
  width=0.1,
  height=0.3)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED [0, THETA_M+TILT, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle
  SPLIT 10

COMPONENT sphere = PSD_monitor_4PI(
  filename="sphere",
  radius=0.5,
  restore_neutron=1)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT mono_out = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED [0, 2*THETA_M, 0] RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT Shield_Hole = Guide_channeled(
  w1=0.05,
  h1=0.274,
  w2=0.044,
  h2=0.201,
  l=0.752,
  R0=0,
  nslit=1)
  AT [0, 0, 0.304] RELATIVE mono_out ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Alpha_Two = Collimator_linear(
  xwidth=0.05,
  yheight=0.2,
  length=0.2,
  divergence=ALPHA2,
  transmission=1.0)
  AT [0, 0, L2-0.25] RELATIVE mono_out ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE
  WHEN (ALPHA2 > 0)

COMPONENT Slit_Sample = Slit(
  xwidth=0.01,
  yheight=0.05)
  AT [0, 0, L2-0.02] RELATIVE mono_out ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D2B_ALPHA2_Div = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth=0.02,
  yheight=0.05,
  bins=40,
  restore_neutron=1,
  options="dx limits=[-0.5 0.5] dy limits=[-1 1]")
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Slit_Sample ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D2B_Sample_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth=0.02,
  yheight=0.05,
  bins=40,
  restore_neutron=1,
  options=lamopts)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE D2B_ALPHA2_Div ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Arm_Sample = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, L2] RELATIVE mono_out ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE
  SPLIT 10

COMPONENT Container_in = PowderN(
  reflections="V.lau",
  radius=0.0025+0.00051,
  yheight=0.04,
  thickness=0.0005,
  d_phi=RAD2DEG*atan2(Dheight+0.05, L3),
  p_interact=0.1,
  concentric=1)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Arm_Sample ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Sample = PowderN(
  reflections=Powder,
  radius=0.0025,
  yheight=0.04,
  d_phi=RAD2DEG*atan2(Dheight+0.05, L3))
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Arm_Sample ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Container_out = PowderN(
  reflections="V.lau",
  radius=0.0025+0.00051,
  yheight=0.04,
  thickness=0.0005,
  d_phi=RAD2DEG*atan2(Dheight+0.05, L3),
  p_interact=0.1,
  concentric=1)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Arm_Sample ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT collimador_radial = Collimator_radial(
  yheight=Dheight,
  length=0.30,
  divergence=ALPHA3,
  theta_min=-165,
  theta_max=-5,
  radius=L3-0.3-0.01,
  verbose=1,
  approx=1)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE
  WHEN (ALPHA3 > 0)

COMPONENT D2B_BananaTheta = Monitor_nD(
  yheight=Dheight,
  restore_neutron=1,
  radius=L3,
  options="banana, angle limits=[5 165], bins=3200")
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D2B_BananaThetaCenter = Monitor_nD(
  yheight=0.1,
  restore_neutron=1,
  radius=L3,
  options="banana, angle limits=[5 165], bins=3200")
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D2B_BananaPSD = Monitor_nD(
  yheight=Dheight,
  radius=L3*1.005,
  options="banana, theta limits=[-165 -5] bins=320, y bins=25")
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Sample ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

END
```
